Questions drivers ask

What are your opening hours?

We are open every day, 10am to 8:30pm.

Where is LT Automart?

183, Jalan Dato Sulaiman, Taman Century, 80250 Johor Bahru. Tap Google Maps or Waze on this page.

Do I need an appointment?

WhatsApp us first with your car model and what you want, and we will arrange a slot.

Which cars do you work on?

All makes. Recent jobs include the Toyota Alphard, Vellfire and Estima, BMW and Mercedes-Benz.

How much does it cost?

Every car is different, so we quote by WhatsApp. Send your car model and year.
